causes.quote: Wind output was low due to calm conditions in South Australia.

causes.quote: A planned outage of one South East to Tailem Bend line limited flows into South Australia on the Heywood interconnector to between 80 MW and 154 MW, compared to its nominal capacity of 600 MW.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The combined outages on the two interconnectors limited South Australia's ability to import low-priced capacity by around 650 MW, while only up to 71 MW of high-priced capacity was needed to meet demand in the energy market.
